• 赎罪Atonement：你接触一个阵营发生了改变的自愿生物，而你进行一次DC20的感知（洞悉）检定。成功则你令目标恢复其原始阵营。
• 祝福圣水Bless Water：你接触一瓶水并将它转变为圣水。
• 成人礼Coming of Age：你接触一个年龄足够成年的类人生物。在接下来的24小时内，当目标进行一次属性检定时，它可以投d4并将投出的结果加到属性检定上。一个生物只能从此仪式中获得此增益一次。
• 献身Dedication：你接触一个自愿转变为你的宗教的信仰或想要为你信奉的神明服务的类人生物。在接下来的24小时内，当目标进行一次豁免检定时，它可以投d4并将投出的结果加到检定上。一个生物只能从此仪式中获得此增益一次。
• 葬礼Funeral Rite：你祝福一具处于你周围5尺内的尸体。在接下来的7天内，目标不能被任何弱于祈愿术wish的方式变为不死生物。
• 婚礼Wedding：你接触自愿接受婚姻的束缚的成年类人生物。在接下来的7天内，每个目标若处于彼此30尺范围内，则在AC上获得+2加值。一个生物只有在丧偶时才能再次从这个仪式中受益。
target:
• You perform one of several religious ceremonies. When you cast this spell, choose one of the ceremonies below. Its targets must remain within 10 feet of you during the casting.
• Atonement: You touch a willing creature whose alignment has changed and make a DC 20 Wisdom (Insight) check. On a success, you restore the target's original alignment.
• Bless Water: You touch a flask of water and transform it into holy water.
• Coming of Age: You touch a humanoid old enough to be an adult. For the next 24 hours, when the target makes an ability check, it can roll a d4 and add the result to the check. A creature can receive this benefit from this ceremony only once.
• Dedication: You touch a humanoid willing to convert to your religion or wishing to serve the deity you worship. For the next 24 hours, when the target makes a saving throw, it can roll a d4 and add the result to the save. A creature can receive this benefit from this ceremony only once.
• Funeral Rite: You bless a corpse within 5 feet of you. For the next 7 days, the target cannot be turned into an undead creature by any means less powerful than Wish.
• Wedding: You touch adult humanoids willing to accept the bonds of marriage. For the next 7 days, each target gains a +2 bonus to AC while within 30 feet of the others. A creature can benefit from this ceremony again only if widowed.

• 你对施法距离内一个你能看见的生物说出一个单词的命令。目标生物必须成功通过一次感知豁免，否则必须在其自己的下一回合服从该命令行事。如果目标为不死生物或目标无法听懂你的语言，又或者你的命令对其直接构成损害，则该法术无效。
• 以下列出一些通常可用的命令单词及其效果。你也可以说出此处没有列明的单词命令，并由DM决定目标将如何行动。如果目标无法完成你的命令，则法术终止。
→过来 Approach：目标以最短最直接的路线向你移动，并在到达距你5尺时结束其回合。
→放下 Drop：目标放下手中持握物并结束其回合。
→走开 Flee：目标在其回合内以最快最有效的方式远离你。
→趴下 Grovel：目标趴下倒地并结束其回合。
→立定 Halt：目标不移动且不作任何动作。飞行生物在原地悬浮（如果它可以这么做）。如果它必须移动才能保持在空中，则其移动最小的距离以保持飞行。

target:
• You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or obey the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, cannot understand your language, or would be directly harmed by your command.
• Some commonly usable command words and their effects are listed below. You can also give a one-word command not listed here; the DM determines how the target acts. If the target cannot complete your command, the spell ends.
→ Approach: The target moves toward you by the shortest, most direct route and ends its turn when it comes within 5 feet of you.
→ Drop: The target drops what it is holding and ends its turn.
→ Flee: The target moves away from you on its turn by the fastest, most effective means available.
→ Grovel: The target falls prone and ends its turn.
→ Halt: The target does not move or take any actions. A flying creature hovers in place if it can. If it must move to stay aloft, it moves the minimum distance needed to keep flying.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell can affect one additional target for each slot level above 1st. The targets must be no more than 30 feet apart.

• 你可以自己每个回合内以一个附赠动作对仆役下达精神命令，使它移动最多15尺并与一个物件进行互动。仆从可以做人类仆从能做到的简单工作，例如拿取东西、打扫卫生、修补东西、叠衣服、点火、上菜、倒酒等。一旦你下达了命令，仆从就会尽全力去做你命令它做的工作直至完成，并在完成任务后静待你的下一个命令。
• 如果你命令仆从做一件需要它离开你身边60尺的工作，则法术随之终止。

• This spell creates an invisible, mindless, incorporeal force that you can command to perform simple tasks until the spell ends. The servant appears on the ground in an unoccupied space within range. It has AC 10, 1 hit point, and Strength 2, and cannot attack. If its hit points drop to 0, the spell ends.
• On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to issue a mental command to the servant, causing it to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object. It can do simple tasks that a human servant could perform, such as fetching things, cleaning, mending, folding clothes, lighting fires, serving food, or pouring wine. Once you give a command, the servant does its best to complete the task, then waits quietly for your next command.
• If you command the servant to perform a task that requires it to go more than 60 feet away from you, the spell ends.
